notes.title: Patch 1.2.0 - Vietnamese localization
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29187116/40777e0d2bf82f7dd49550c381cd435c72cf4a53.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

We just released a Beyond Eden 1.2.0 version.
From this version you can play the game in Vietnamese.

Thanks the [url=https://twitter.com/the_circus_team]Rạp Xiếc[/url] for the wonderful work!

We hope you will enjoy an exciting experience at Ashgrove Park.

Also, the demo version is also available in Vietnamese from now on!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/649090/

Hello everyone, 
We just released a Beyond Eden 1.1.3 version.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29187116/1272b88e9087a42d8cf7b67318c498ddc219596f.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

We just released a Beyond Eden 1.1.2 version.
[list]
[*]Added Russian localization
[*]Fixed some English typos (You can report typo or unnatural sentences [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/632800/discussions/0/1482109512313793356/]here[/url])
[*]UI improvements including main menu[/list]

Finally, we thank the [url=https://twitter.com/thgofficialtl]Russian translation team[/url] for the wonderful work!

We just released Patch 1.0.2 - a small update that fixed problems with achievement and typos.

    [*]Fixed some typos. (You can report typo or unnatural sentences [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/632800/discussions/0/1482109512313793356/]here[/url])
